cells.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE isolated premium low-poly crystal sculpture of an ANATOMICALLY CORRECT FRIENDLY HANDSHAKE for Huellas Bible-study website, on genuine transparent alpha, square image. Completely fresh composition: two HUMAN RIGHT HANDS in a standard conventional handshake, seen clearly from the SIDE at a slight three-quarter angle. Short wrists enter from the left and right at approximately the same horizontal height; avoid the very high V-shaped forearms. Carefully construct a plausible human grip rather than a knot of fingers. The nearer hand's thumb lies naturally across the back of the farther hand, with its web connected to the palm near the wrist. The near hand's FOUR FINGERS curl together under the other hand in four clear gently stepped parallel segments: index, middle, ring and little finger, each attached to the same palm. Show exactly FOUR curled finger tips along the lower edge and one clearly recognizable thumb above; the other hand's four fingers are mostly hidden by the grip and its thumb may be partially occluded. Only two hands, five digits per hand; natural occlusion is essential. Do not add any extra protruding finger on either side of the clasp. No stray thumb on the lower left. No extra fingertip or extra nail between the four lower fingers. No tangled interlacing of separate fingers, no branching fingers, no fused mitten, no duplicated or floating joints. Hands firmly clasped with an obvious palm-to-palm connection and clearly separate wrists. Style: sophisticated three-dimensional angular crystalline/origami sculpture, medium sized sharply defined TRIANGULAR FACETS with jade/emerald shadows, mint green #83dfbd, seafoam and pale cyan highlights, subtle dimensional lighting confined to surfaces. Match a modern contemplative dark navy website's geometric sculpture language, no photoreal skin, no flat clip art. Favor a clean simple readable silhouette and correct anatomy over decorative complexity. Whole sculpture fully visible within middle 80 percent of square frame with generous clear padding all around. No background, checkerboard, environment, platform, cast shadow, outer glow, particles, text, logo, cross, symbols, frame, extra hands, or extra objects.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: ONE isolated transparent replacement illustration for Huellas, a dark Bible study website. The input atlas is a STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCE only, especially the warm amber/gold faceted oil lamp in the lower left. Replace the concept of that lamp with ONE mature TREE WITH CLEARLY VISIBLE SPREADING ROOTS, symbolizing origins, foundations, history, growth and identity. Do NOT include a lamp, wings, scroll, praying hands or an atlas. Premium three-dimensional low-poly triangular crystalline/origami sculpture matching the reference. A sturdy central golden-ochre trunk divides into several natural branches and a balanced leafy crown made of large clean angular clusters, then transitions seamlessly downward into a generous, intricate but clearly readable exposed branching root system. The roots must be a major part of the design: approximately the lower THIRD of the tree, several thick roots splitting into smaller tapered angular roots, extending left, right and downward, naturally connected to the trunk. There is NO soil, pot, earth ball, rock base, platform or ground line hiding the roots. Warm honey/gold and champagne facets #ebc57d, bronze-ochre trunk and roots; muted olive-gold and warm sage foliage with restrained cool mint reflections, maintaining the original warm golden identity and dimensional facet lighting. Clearly a living leafy tree, not a flame, antlers, coral, bare winter tree, circuit board, wire tree, or Christmas tree. Composition: ONE centered tree on a SQUARE canvas, roots completely visible, canopy fully inside frame, balanced crown and root width, generous genuinely transparent padding, the entire subject within the middle 80 percent of canvas width and height. Genuine alpha transparency; no checkerboard drawing, backdrop color, ground shadow, exterior glow, particles, text, letters, logo, cross, UI, frame or additional objects.
